description: Removes a phone from the account: it is no longer called in any project. Irreversible — to use the same number again, it must be added and confirmed in the Statuser panel once more.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: notification_phone_remove
title: Remove a phone for outage calls
